classification_rationale: The customer is asking for a late-return fee to be waived because of a traffic delay, which is a waiver request the return-logistics policy already settles one way or the other.

draft.reply_body:
Hi,

Thanks for letting us know what happened. Unfortunately, our late return fee applies regardless of the reason for the delay, including traffic - this is standard across all rentals, so we're not able to waive the 300 EUR charge for booking RB-20265951 in this case.

We know that's not the answer you were hoping for. If it helps going forward, letting the depot know before the return deadline that a return will be late gets you one fee-free grace day per rolling 12 months, so it's worth keeping in mind next time.

We're still working on the delivery options for the 20kVA generator and will come back to you separately on that.

Best regards,
Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager, Haapaharju Oy

commitments.description: Declines to waive the late return fee for the mini dumper, since traffic delays are not a waivable reason under policy
Mentions the one-per-year grace day available for returns notified as late before the deadline
Reassures the customer that the generator delivery options are still being checked as previously promised
